clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Moonrage Darksouls wear enchanted fetters forged under Archmage Arugal’s direction. Forsaken mages at the Sepulcher seek them to learn how the magic gripping the region can be undone.

Archmage Arugal’s magic could not fully command or sustain the worgen he unleashed upon Silverpine Forest. He bound enchanted implements such as Darksoul Shackles to the beasts to make up for that failing. The fetters channel outside sorcery into the Moonrage Darksouls, strengthening them and anchoring the curse that keeps them thrall to Shadowfang Keep.
